verdict.rationale: No option clearly dominates once the stated legitimate criteria conflict. A favors nonstop flying but requires a ground transfer with unspecified cost and inconvenience. B avoids the Santa Fe ground transfer and has one flight connection, though it entails a long layover. C is the lowest fare and arrives earliest but has two relatively short connections. D is a simpler one-stop all-air itinerary with early arrival but is materially more expensive. Because all arrive sufficiently before dinner and no weighting of price, connection risk, ground-transfer tolerance, or schedule buffer is supplied, a unique lead recommendation cannot be selected.
